4. Ārdrā, ‘moist,’ is the name of the brilliant star, α Orionis.
But the names by which it is styled, in the plural as Ārdrās in
the Śāṅkhāyana Gṛhya Sūtra^71 and the Nakṣatrakalpa,^72 and
in the dual as Bāhū, in the Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa,^73 point to a
constellation of two or more stars, and it may be noted^74 that
